answer: A farm scripting its whole army of identities fires them together, which means the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 67 aliases out costs the operator real scheduling effort per key. The shale detector writes to violet, and jetty makes public every merge. Submissions that land within 271 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
